messages.subject: Harrow / Brevdale Castings - bundle for hearing
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Quick one on the other Harrow matter - the Brevdale Castings dispute. Counsel's clerk has asked for the updated hearing bundle by Friday. I've paginated sections A-D; can you confirm whether the amended defence should go in section C before I finalise? This is nothing to do with the Melbourne Sealtech claim, just want to keep the two straight.

Thanks,
Donna
Practice Assistant
